posts.name: Rahul Barakoti
posts.cooked:
Hello, I was giving the OPPE for System commands and noticed that some test cases were shown as failed, but my output and the expected output look the same (screenshot attached). Could you please review it

Could you please review it?

Screenshot 2025-08-16 2130061919×1079 140 KB

posts.name: Thumula Praneeth Rao
posts.cooked: If you could look carefully space is being appended for every line of output. So, there are bugs in your script. That’s why your public test cases are failed.

posts.name: Parthiv Kumar
posts.cooked: can u explain me the red , green highlighting .Even after reading I wasnt able to comprehend it fully

posts.name: Thumula Praneeth Rao
posts.cooked: Red is actual output and green one is expected output.

posts.name: Rahul Barakoti
posts.cooked: I didn’t get it. Can you please explain it in detail?

posts.name: Parthiv Kumar
posts.cooked:
like I was confused with how it said it would not display if its right (something of that sorts).
Because sometimes when I ran my code it was all red and no green and sometimes all green .

Is there any way (re oppe) so i could just get just my output when i eval?

posts.name: Thumula Praneeth Rao
posts.cooked: the text highlighted in red is printed by your script and the text highlighted in green is the answer. You output(in red) should match with actual output (in green).

posts.name: Thumula Praneeth Rao
posts.cooked:
If your script is correct, it just prints testcases passed but if there is any difference between your output(in red) and actual output(in green) it prints both outputs. If your script outputs nothing, only actual output(green) will be shown. It indicates that your script is not printing anything.

I suggest you to go through evaluation script and try and understand it once. It’s almost same except for the few lines, those lines depends on the given question.

posts.name: Parthiv Kumar
posts.cooked:
where can i get it ? (like the copy of the instructions which was given during oppe)
can u share plz

posts.name: Rahul Barakoti
posts.cooked: yes but in the screen shot it’s matching.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
OPPE question matching output but failed private cases System Commands
If the diff output shows a difference, it might not be visible but there will always be a difference between your and expected output. We have verified with correct solution that it will work if your code is correct. Here you might be removing the last \t character from the line, which was part of expected output.
